retain_custom_instructions: Extract concise English facts only. Name the subject of the record and its condition within the first 64 tokens of every fact, and keep every non-English literal beside its exact English alias; do not translate away either name. Extract no facts from administrative frontmatter: schema_version, record_id, kind, scope, owner_ref, sources, horizon, review_on, recall_terms, derived_from or codified_in. Title, subject and abstract orient the substantive body; do not duplicate the same claim. Preserve meaningful protocol identifiers and every recall term exactly. Aim for at most 256 tokens per fact.
